messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need a one-sheet + two launch posts + webinar blurb for deploy-mode messaging (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Must clearly call out security controls, SLA tiers, and inbound routing.
aj: Ill draft the one-pager and one social post. Need an ops-verified blurb for latency/SLA numbers before final.
ron: Field wants a compact compare line per mode: risk, SLA tier headline, buyer fit, and one-line recommended next step. Keep each under 12 words.
devops-bot: Benchmarks uploaded: /benchmarks/deploy_mode_field_brief.csv — preliminary clusters show 15-35% unit-cost improvements with batching+KV cache depending on model and prompt shape. Use conservative phrasing.
maya: Let's use "up to ~35%" with a strong footnote: "varies by model, sequence length, and prompt shape." Also include a short failover note: model fallback + region routing + dedicated-capacity spillover.
aj: Draft CTAs: Primary = "Request a Dedicated Eval" (field), Secondary = "Start a Free Trial" (self-serve). Routing: high-intent -> Sales Ops; compliance-heavy -> Security review; trial -> SDR nurture.
webinar-bot: Scheduled: "Deploy Mode Decision Framework for Regulated Apps" Thu 2026-10-07 10:00 PT. Reg: https://events.redwood/dep-modes-10-07
maya: Aim to have first drafts in drive by tomorrow 09:30 PT for 10:00 review. Please drop a :thumbsup: when you post copy.
